facts.text: Combining simulation and physical evidence means using many virtual runs for statistical volume and fewer physical tests to establish simulation trustworthiness, jointly supporting a claim neither could support alone.
facts.quote: Combining simulation and physical evidence means using a large number of virtual runs to supply the statistical volume and a smaller number of physical tests to prove that the simulation can be trusted, so that the two together support a claim neither could support alone.

facts.text: A 1 percent miss claim in each of 20 critical strata requires about 6,000 zero-miss trials, which the booklet considers feasible only in simulation or hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing.
facts.quote: A 1 percent miss claim in each of 20 critical strata needs about 6,000 zero-miss trials, feasible only in simulation or hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing.

facts.text: Physical tests validate simulation in each critical stratum and provide independent smaller-sample confirmation; the booklet gives 59 physical trials per stratum as an example supporting at least 95 percent detection.
facts.quote: Physical tests then validate the simulation in each stratum and give an independent smaller-sample confirmation, for example 59 physical trials per stratum to support at least 95 percent detection.

facts.text: Before the prototype arrives, every high-value simulated phenomenon—dust, fog, glare, wet surfaces, reflective objects and sensor blockage—gets a smaller physical reference set.
facts.quote: Before the prototype arrives, every high-value simulated phenomenon (dust, fog, glare, wet surfaces, reflective objects, sensor blockage) gets a smaller physical reference set

facts.text: Simulation is credible only where paired simulation and physical reference tests agree.
facts.quote: the simulation is credible only where these paired tests agree [Chapter 9].

facts.text: The booklet gives no fixed ratio for how many virtual runs one physical test can anchor.
facts.quote: How many virtual runs can one physical test anchor? The booklet gives no fixed ratio.

facts.text: Multi-fidelity analysis and Bayesian updating are established in principle, but how many virtual runs a physical test can anchor depends on the prior strength accepted by an assessor and a documented toolchain credibility assessment.
facts.quote: Multi-fidelity analysis and Bayesian updating are established in principle, but the answer depends on the prior strength an assessor accepts and on a documented credibility assessment of the toolchain.

facts.text: The UNECE New Assessment/Test Method (NATM) says its credibility framework will define the envelope in which a virtual tool can be used; UNECE is the United Nations Economic Commission for Europe.
facts.quote: The UNECE New Assessment/Test Method (NATM; UNECE is the United Nations Economic Commission for Europe) says its credibility framework "will define the envelope in which the virtual tool can be used".

entities.name: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe

facts.text: The booklet found no off-road regulator acceptance of simulation-based rate claims.
facts.quote: No off-road regulator acceptance of simulation-based rate claims was found

facts.text: Physical testing remained present in every precedent reviewed in Chapter 2.
facts.quote: in every precedent in Chapter 2 physical testing never disappeared [Chapter 9, Chapter 2].

facts.text: The booklet's example combined-evidence claim specifies reverse low-speed worker encounters sampled according to distribution P over a declared operating domain, with a one-sided 95% lower confidence bound on successful stopping of at least X.
facts.quote: "For reverse low-speed worker encounters sampled according to distribution P over the declared operating domain, the one-sided 95% lower confidence bound on successful stopping is at least X"

facts.text: Combining simulation and physical evidence is the entire logic of the booklet's four-month plan, and credibility is the plan's weakest link.
facts.quote: This combination is the entire logic of the four-month plan. Its weakest link is credibility

facts.text: The booklet rates radar and ultrasonic simulation in dust as low credibility until validated against the company's own measurements.
